prompt:
Edit Image 1 by replacing its shell-shop illustration with the EXACT octopus character from Image 2. Produce ONE combined UI mockup, not alternatives.

USE CASE: ui-mockup / compositing.
TARGET DIMENSIONS: match Image 1 exactly, with its original aspect ratio and full dialog framing.

REFERENCE ROLES:
Image 1 is the BASE AND EDIT TARGET: the centered shell-shop dialog with gold "101", dark teal "coins needed", pale underwater backdrop, blank blue header, red X and centered green OPEN SHOP button.
Image 2 is a CHARACTER DONOR ONLY: use its coral-orange octopus holding a gold star coin. Do not copy Image 2's left-aligned typography, asymmetric layout, button location or turquoise background patch.

REQUESTED CHANGE:
Remove the entire shell building, awning, counter and coin sign from Image 1. In the same central illustration area, place the octopus from Image 2. Preserve the octopus's character identity closely: same coral-orange color, rounded spotted head, large shiny teal eyes, eyebrows, friendly smile, shaded suckers and curling tentacle shapes; same raised tentacle holding ONE gold star coin and same free tentacle reaching gently toward the action. It must look like the same octopus, not a newly designed mascot.
Scale and position the octopus as one centered hero illustration on the sandy floor where the shell shop was. Its full head, tentacles and held coin must fit comfortably between the heading and button. The TOP of the octopus and coin must be below the BOTTOM of the heading, with a clear gap. The BOTTOM of every tentacle must stay above the top edge of the button, again with a clear gap. Center the overall character-and-coin silhouette beneath the heading, not at the right edge.
Keep the coral, little rocks and soft underwater background from Image 1 where they fit naturally around the replacement. Fill the area revealed by the removed shell with the same pale aqua-and-ivory backdrop and sand. Add only a subtle contact shadow beneath the octopus.

PRESERVE EVERYTHING ELSE FROM IMAGE 1:
- Identical outer blue outline, corners and framing.
- Identical empty navy wave header and red X. Absolutely no header title.
- Identical centered SINGLE-LINE "101 coins needed" at the same position and size, with "101" in gold and the rest dark teal.
- Identical centered glossy green "OPEN SHOP" button at the same position and size.
- Same warm cream, pale aqua and sand palette, spacing and visual style.
Do not add, remove or rewrite any UI content except the shell-shop replacement. The visible text remains exactly "101 coins needed", "OPEN SHOP" and "X". Never reintroduce "NOT ENOUGH COINS" or the shop hint sentence. No extra text, prices, buttons, watermarks, labels, captions or frames. No stretching, clipping, or overlap.
